observations.dag_granularity: Recomputed directly from both fixtures' final .dev-graph/state/graph.json (not the audit's summary): 5 nodes (1 architecture + 4 features + 0 tasks), depends_on edges = dashboard/notification/admin-report -> user-auth only (3 edges), acyclic star shape, max inter-feature depends_on = 1 <= declared max_value=3 (metric=max_inter_feature_depends_on_per_feature, per scenario file live-trial-positive-scenarios.json). Audit's own 'graph' block (measured_max=1, threshold_pass=true) matches this independent count exactly for both beads and none fixtures.
observations.draft_zero_reasons: Verified via audit binding_projections (both fixture audit files) that zero-issue attribution is never conflated: drafts (feat-dashboard/notification/admin-report) carry zero_attribution='draft-gate' in every binding view; github carries zero_attribution='binding-route-unreachable' + route_declarable=false backed by an actual validate-graph-schema.py stdin receipt showing 'schema_violation|$.github_publication.mode: not in enum [issue, issue_and_projects]'; the non-active tracker binding in each run (beads in the none-run, none in the beads-run) carries a distinct 'not-exercised-by-run'/'binding-route-absent' label. All three reasons are structurally distinct fields, not restatements of one flag.
observations.sole_candidate: Raw graph.json in both fixtures shows exactly one node (feat-user-auth-001) with confirmation_status=confirmed, evaluation_status=pass, implementation_readiness.status=complete; the other 3 features remain confirmation_status=draft/evaluation_status=pending/readiness=incomplete. Audit's publication_gate independently confirms excludes_every_draft=true, candidate_node_ids=[feat-user-auth-001], discriminates=true. Graph revision history (0->6 in beads trace) shows this came from real writes, not a no-op run.
observations.binding_routes: Transcript shows two separate Skill-invocation sequences (beads fixture, then none fixture), each running the full 13-step sequence independently. beads audit: binding_projections.beads.exercised_by_run=true with persisted_node_ids=all 5 nodes and beads_issue dry-run receipt (returncode 0); binding_projections.none.exercised_by_run=false, persisted_node_ids=[]. none audit: exactly inverted (none.exercised_by_run=true/5 nodes, beads.exercised_by_run=false/persisted_node_ids=[]). github.route_declarable=false and exercised_by_run=false in both, with the schema rule shown above. Since persisted_node_ids differs correctly per fixture's actual tracker_binding field (not per the --run-binding argument), the figures are graph-derived, not audit-input-restated.
observations.write_counts_stdin: local_state.before (both audits) is byte-identical to the standalone eval-log/pre-state.json snapshot taken in step 3; local_state.after/publication_delta shows issues.count and beads_export.count unchanged (1 and 0 respectively, only issues/.gitkeep pre-existing) confirming write_counts (local_issue_files=0, beads_export_records=0, beads_linked_nodes=0, github_linked_nodes=0, github_project_linkages=0 per node) are true pre/post diffs, not skill self-reports. Transcript step 9 shows the literal command 'cat .../macro-preview.json | python3 validate-graph-schema.py --graph - --repo-root ...' for both fixtures, and audit's schema_validation.stdin_path_used=true confirms the stdin path was actually exercised — no temp file written inside either managed repo (git status shows no stray tmp artifacts).
observations.evidence_digest: Independently recomputed sha256(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in node.items() if k!='confirmation_evidence'}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) directly from each fixture's final graph.json feat-user-auth-001 node: beads -> 5096dd60...b9b8aff matches node's declared confirmation_evidence.evaluated_digest exactly; none -> 7b46ebea...747b05f1e8cf matches exactly. Both also match the audit's evidence_binding.checks entry for that node (digest_matches=true, promoted=true). The 3 non-promoted drafts correctly show digest_matches=false/evaluated_digest=null since they were never promoted, so no interchangeable/placeholder-evidence risk.
observations.negative_controls: Both decompose-audit.json files contain gate_negative_controls.all_rejected=true with two controls: 'readiness_clause' (confirmed+pass+incomplete-readiness mutation of feat-admin-report-001 -> rejected with $.implementation_readiness.status/checked_at schema_violations) and 'publication_intent_on_blocked_node' (github_publication.mode=issue on a gate-blocked draft -> rejected with schema_violation on artifact_kind/confirmation_status/evaluation_status/github_publication.mode). Both controls were run through the same validate-graph-schema.py validator invoked elsewhere in the run (identical schema_violation vocabulary as the real stdin validation), so the rejection is falsifiable on this run's own data, not asserted in prose.
